serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Lady Annalie: Done! Oh, you weren’t joking with only now creating accounts. Glad to be your first friend~
#bot.Expression.Blush
Bot: Me too. 
#bot.Expression.NoBlush
#bot.Expression.VeryHappy
This girl… {{wi}}we have known each other for quite some time now, but she never proposed adding me to friends.
Not that I have any accounts. I thought these websites are stupid during highschool and I tried them out only because of my ex.
After she was done with me I quickly deleted them. I’m not interested in what people I haven't met in a few years are up to anyway.
But it doesn’t matter! What matters is the sole gesture! 
She also could just tell me her number.
D-does she actually hate me?
M-maybe I should just ask her about it?
You: H-hey Annalie, how come you never asked for my social media?
Lady Annalie: Hmmm…
#Annalie.Face.pervyGrin
#bot.Expression.NoHappy
Lady Annalie: Maybe I just wasn’t that interested in you, huh?
This girl! Does she really wanna hurt my feelings or something?!
Lady Annalie: Ohh~ You gonna cry?
#bot.Expression.Angry
#Annalie.Face.shocked
Bot: Stop bullying him.
#Annalie.Face.pervyGrin
Lady Annalie: Ohh~ Both of you are such sweethearts ♥ Look at {f_botName}, defending her boyfriend~ 
#bot.Expression.NoAngry
#Annalie.Face.normal
Lady Annalie: It was just a joke of course. I just can’t help it sometimes.
#Annalie.Face.pervyGrin
Lady Annalie: Don’t take it personally, ok Anon-kyun~?
#Annalie.Face.normal
You: I think I had enough of your jokes for today.
Lady Annalie: To be honest, I just didn’t think about it. You seemed a little secretive anyway.
Lady Annalie: If you want we can add each other too…
#Annalie.Face.pervyGrin
Lady Annalie: …if your girl is ok with it, that is.
#Annalie.Face.normal
Bot: It’s fine with me.
Lady Annalie: There you have it! 
You: I don’t have any accounts and I don’t plan on using them like {f_botName}. Is exchanging phone numbers ok with you?
Lady Annalie: Sure! 
Lady Annalie: But I must say that I’m not even one bit surprised that you don’t have any socials. I can see it in your eyes~
You: Is that some super power of yours or something?
Lady Annalie: Not really. I think that anyone could tell this much just by looking at you.
You: …
You: Alright, how about we look for some clothes now? You already had your fun, right Annalie?
#Annalie.Face.pervyGrin
Lady Annalie: Oh no, fun is just about to begin hehe~
